title: 第8章
content:
王多多放下茶杯，歪了下脑袋，疑惑得拿起，顺便用手掂了一下。“哟，还挺沉。”只见书册的外面是由黑色外皮包裹，封面上头还有一条金带用扣子扣紧，四个角还特意做了镶金花纹，非常精致。王金虎也低头喝了口热茶，“是照片。”“什么照片？”“乐安所有世家的优质适婚年龄的高级alpha的照片，都在里头了”“什么！”王多多瞪大了眼眸。他得大脑里迅速放起了烟花，‘唰唰唰’通通炸了。王多多停住了手，刚被解开书皮外层的纽扣，又小心翼翼得合上了。这东西烫手了。“爸，你该…该不会是？”“想要给我相…相亲吧？”“嗯，算是吧”王金虎淡淡抬起眼眸，难得语重心长。“你年纪也到了，我就你这一个孩子，又是个omega，总归是要嫁人得，是该找一个合适的alpha照顾你”“等你生了孩子，也好继承我这点产业，那我也好放心了，我就指着你能给我早点生个小alpha，继承王家。”王多多震惊得嘴巴都快张成o型的了。“不是，爸！”“哪有你这么着急得！”"我才24！”“你是我生得，不用你提醒我，你今年几岁了。”“我今天才大学毕业！”“啊，可不就等你毕业嘛”“我还小！”“哪小了？”“你爸我也是24岁就有了你，等你再长几岁，上了30，都不好生养了。”王多多脸都快被气绿了。他气急败坏道，“什么不好生养，我就是到了30岁，40岁照样能生！爸，你不能年龄歧视！”“嗷，不对，什么生不生得，爸，你不能偷换概念！”“我怎么就偷换概念了？”王多多双手抱胸，后背靠在沙发背上，脸鼓的像是河豚。

“我是omega，我得矜持！”“我才不要相亲，相亲对omega很不友好！这是才侮辱omega的人格，你总不能把你的宝贝儿子往火坑里推啊！”“你这叫什么话，我又不是把你卖了。”“你现在可不就是要把我卖了吗，试问谁不知道相亲就是卖娃的代名词，你还想着让我生崽子，还想着卖一赠一，怎么联邦的好处都让alpha得去了，这不公平！”“瞎喊什么，从小到大，你爸我哪点对你不好了？”“那你还非让我相亲结婚，非让我生崽子。”老王气哼道，“你还好意思提，就前两年我带你去‘夜宴城’，你这学不会，那又不行，底下跟着的那些人叫苦连连。”“私底下的人哪个不冲我喊，说只要小王多在一天，他们身上的结节就多长一个。为了他们多活一年，他们个个来求我把你领回家，当时我那张老脸都要被你丢尽儿！”王多多羞窘得别过脸，“可...我...那...那也不能怪我呀，我也很想努力得啊，可我哪想到，做生意这么难也就算了，管理还更难，我...”老王摆了摆手，“别说了，都是我的错，怪我没给你生好，都说隔代遗传几率高，我现在不指望你的脑子，就指望你的肚子，老王家基因不行，那咱就再找个好的alpha基因综合一下。”王多多立马急得转身，“不行！万一那个alpha不行怎么办，万一我的基因强大，生出来的又是omega，还随我怎么办?”王金虎冷着脸。“那就继续生，你生一个足球队我都养得起！”“反正生下来的孩子都姓王！”“什么！”王多多震得魂都要飞了。“还有，这册子里的世家都同意自家小辈入赘，还都是资质出色的高级alpha，我就不信你生不出一个基因好的小alpha。”“哦，你不是要公平嘛，你一样生一个，只要可以独当一面，只能继承王家，能管‘夜宴城’；小alpha，小omega，小beta我都可以。”“我得天爷啊~”来道天雷，把老王劈醒吧！王多多双手抱头，揉搓着头发，他真的要被气吐血了。合着他成王家的超级大种马了！“哭嗷什么，这十几家的alpha，我刚都仔细看了一遍，模样都还行，没那么糟。”王多多眼泪汪汪，“什么叫没那么糟，你这样说，我心情更糟了。”他扯上王金虎的衣袖，可怜兮兮得看着他。“爸，我长那么大，一次恋爱都没有谈过，除了你这个当爹的，我甚至都没有摸过alpha的一根手指头”“那不正好，爸把机会摆在你面前了。”“只要你结婚了，想怎么摸就怎么摸，人都是你的。”

Wang Duoduo put down the tea cup, tilted his head, picked it up in confusion, and weighed it with his hands."Oh, it's quite heavy." I saw that the outside of the book was wrapped in black leather, and there was a gold belt on the cover that was fastened with buttons. The four corners were specially decorated with gold inlays, which was very delicate.Wang Jinhu also lowered his head and took a sip of hot tea, "It's a photo." "What photo?" "Photos of high-quality senior alphas of marriageable age from all Le'an aristocratic families are in it." "What!" Wang Duoduo's eyes widened.Fireworks were quickly set off in his brain, and they all exploded.Wang Duoduo stopped, and just after undoing the outer buttons of the book cover, he carefully closed them again.This thing is hot."Dad, should you...should it be?" "You want to go on a blind date...for me?" "Well, that's right." Wang Jinhu raised his eyes lightly, rarely speaking seriously."You have reached your age. I only have your child, and you are an omega. You have to get married after all, so you should find a suitable alpha to take care of you." "When you give birth to a child, you can inherit my inheritance, then I can rest assured. I will ask you to give me a little alpha as soon as possible and inherit the Wang family." Wang Duoduo was so shocked that his mouth almost opened into an O shape."No, dad!" "How can you be so anxious!" "I'm only 24!" "You were born to me. You don't need to remind me how old you are this year." "I just graduated from college today!" "Ah, why don't I just wait for you to graduate?" "I'm still young!" "How young?" "Your dad, I also had you when I was 24 years old. When you get older and turn 30, it won't be easy to have children." Wang Duoduo's face was almost green with anger.He said angrily, "Why is it difficult to have children? I can still have children even when I am 30 or 40 years old! Dad, you can't discriminate based on age!" "Oh, no, it's not possible to have children. Dad, you can't change your mind!" "Why did I change my mind?" Wang Duoduo folded his arms and leaned against the back of the sofa, his face bulging like a puffer fish.

"I'm an omega, I have to be reserved!" "I don't want blind dates. Blind dates are very unfriendly to omegas! This is an insult to an omega's character. You can't push your precious son into a pit of fire!" "What do you mean, I'm not selling you." "Aren't you just going to sell me now? Who doesn't know that blind dates are synonymous with selling babies? You still want me to give birth to a baby, and you still want to sell one for one,Why do all the benefits of the federation go to alpha?It's not fair!" "What are you talking about?What has your father done wrong to you since you were a child?" "Then you still insist on letting me get married and have children."Wang snorted angrily, "You still have the nerve to mention that I took you to the 'Ye Banquet City' two years ago. You couldn't learn this, and you couldn't do it. The people following me complained endlessly."Every day Wang Duoduo grows, one more knot will appear on their body.In order for them to live one more year, they all come to beg me to take you home.At that time, my old face was completely embarrassed by you!" Wang Duoduo looked away in embarrassment, "But...I...then...you can't blame me. I also want to work hard, but I never thought that business is so difficult, and management is even harder. I..." Old Wang waved his hand, "Stop talking.It's all my fault. It's my fault that I didn't give you a good child. They say the probability of inheritance is high. I don't count on your brain now, but on your belly. If the old Wang family's genes are not good, then let's find a good alpha gene and combine it." Wang Duoduo immediately turned around anxiously, "No!What if that alpha doesn't work?What if my genes are strong and the child is an omega? What should I do?" Wang Jinhu said with a cold face."Then keep having children. I can even support a football team if you give birth!" "Anyway, all the children born will be named Wang!" "What!" Wang Duoduo was so shocked that his soul almost flew away."Also, all the aristocratic families in this book agree that their juniors will marry into the family, and they are all high-level alphas with excellent qualifications. I don't believe you can't give birth to a little alpha with good genes." "Oh, don't you want to be fair? You can give birth to one as well. As long as you can stand alone, you can only inherit the Wang family and manage the 'Ye Banquet City'; I can do it all, a little alpha, a little omega, and a little beta." "Oh my God~" Let's hit the sky thunder and wake up Old Wang!Wang Duoduo held his head in his hands and rubbed his hair. He was really angry and wanted to vomit blood.He has become the super stallion of the Wang family!"Why are you crying? I just took a closer look at the alphas from these dozens of companies. They all look okay and not that bad." Wang Duoduo burst into tears. "What do you mean it's not that bad? When you say that, I feel even worse." He pulled on Wang Jinhu's sleeves and looked at him pitifully."Dad, in my whole life, I have never been in love. Except for you as a father, I have never even touched an alpha's finger." "That's not good. Dad has put the opportunity in front of you." "As long as you get married, you can touch him however you want. He is yours."
